sample_data.method: Preloaded published fixture cases (PUB-01 to PUB-25) and custom case JSON file upload modal
sample_data.reset_instructions: Select any case (PUB-01 to PUB-25) from the top-navbar dropdown to instantly load its telemetry, or click 'Reset Authoritative Default' on the Tariff page.

problem_solving_method: Built a deterministic integer-cents financial engine using TypeScript, Next.js 15, and Tailwind CSS to eliminate floating-point drift. Implemented authoritative BERC LT-A tiered slab allocation, first-recharge monthly fixed charge deductions, daily depletion runway projection, 4-part target-date cost decomposition, and strict invariant-tested habit comparison.

R1.evidence: app/case-data/page.tsx, lib/validation/case-schema.ts, lib/data/case-loader.ts (ingests and validates all 25 public cases PUB-01 to PUB-25 and custom JSON files with seasonal classification)

R2.evidence: app/simulation/page.tsx, lib/engine/meter-engine.ts, lib/engine/tariff-engine.ts (deterministic day-by-day balance timeline, running calendar-month unit resets, and deposit tracking)

R3.evidence: app/advisor/page.tsx, lib/engine/depletion-engine.ts, lib/engine/advisor-engine.ts (exact depletion date runway and 4-part target recharge math: base energy, slab tier effect, fixed charges, VAT)

R4.evidence: app/comparison/page.tsx, lib/engine/comparison-engine.ts, tests/comparison.test.ts (3-month strategy comparison proving identical energy consumption and zero rate arbitrage with strict invariant tests)

team_members.major_contribution: Full-stack development: BERC LT-A calculation engine, integer-cents math, interactive 3D digital meter twin, audit ledger, and PDF report export

major_design_decisions: Used integer-cents Money utility (lib/utils/money.ts) across all arithmetic to guarantee zero floating-point rounding errors and 100% deterministic reproducibility
Implemented calendar-month slab counter resets on the 1st of every month per official Bangladesh BERC LT-A prepaid rules
Deducted monthly fixed charges (Demand Charge + Single-Phase Meter Rent) on the first recharge deposit event of each calendar month
Constructed 4-part additive cost decomposition for future target-date recharge calculations (Base Energy + Higher Slab Tier + Fixed Charges + VAT)
Ensured strict equal-cost verification (Delta BDT 0.00) for habit comparison under identical monthly consumption
known_limitations: Custom uploaded cases must adhere to the standard JSON schema with consecutive daily readings starting from the 1st of a month

ai_tools_used.used_for: Pair-programming, BERC LT-A multi-tier slab calculation logic, comprehensive 112-test suite development, and responsive UI design
ai_tools_used.how_output_was_verified: Verified with 112 Vitest automated tests covering all 25 public cases (101 regression tests), TypeScript compiler checks, and build validation
